rootCauseInvestigation.summary: The runtime exception 'ReferenceError: Loader2 is not defined' in the deployed Vercel bundle 'index-BEer72a7.js' is NOT originating from AuthButton.tsx. It originates from an unimported '<Loader2 />' JSX tag inside the root 'App.tsx' component in the GitHub commit that was deployed to Vercel.

exactCodeLocationInDeployedBundle.snippet: r.jsx("div",{className:"w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#10b981]/10 border border-[#10b981]/30 flex items-center justify-center",children:r.jsx(Loader2,{className:"w-6 h-6 text-[#10b981] animate-spin"})})
exactCodeLocationInDeployedBundle.containingFunction: bxe (mapped to App component in src/App.tsx in deployed commit)

discrepancyBetweenDeployedAndLocal.deployedCommit: Contains legacy loading screen in App.tsx with '<Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 text-[#10b981] animate-spin" />' but lacks 'import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react"' in App.tsx.
discrepancyBetweenDeployedAndLocal.localWorkspace: App.tsx was already updated to delegate loading and auth gating to <AccountStatusGate />. In local workspace App.tsx, zero Loader2 references exist, and local builds (index-Bf1E5dSb.js) contain zero free Loader2 identifiers.
discrepancyBetweenDeployedAndLocal.authButtonStatus: AuthButton.tsx in both local and deployed bundle properly compiles to 'r.jsx(m1, ...)' where m1 is the valid Lucide loader-circle icon factory. AuthButton is NOT the source of the active error.

chainAnalysis.1_gitCommit: GitHub repository 'rexat007/Q-Saudi-Work-Follow-App' on branch 'main' was deployed with an earlier commit containing the unimported Loader2 JSX in App.tsx.
chainAnalysis.2_workingTree: Local working tree is clean and already removed the unimported Loader2 block from App.tsx.
chainAnalysis.3_dependencyResolution: lucide-react resolved to version 0.546.0 in lockfile and node_modules.
chainAnalysis.5_compilationTransformation: Vite/esbuild JSX transform converted '<Loader2 />' in App.tsx directly to 'r.jsx(Loader2, ...)' as a free global variable because App.tsx had no import statement for Loader2 in that commit.
chainAnalysis.6_localVsVercelBuild: Local fresh build emits 'index-Bf1E5dSb.js' (clean, 0 free Loader2 identifiers). Vercel deployed 'index-BEer72a7.js' (contains 1 free Loader2 identifier at byte 3,545,383 inside App.tsx).
chainAnalysis.7_rootCauseLayer: SOURCE_CODE_IN_DEPLOYED_COMMIT_MISMATCH (GitHub branch main contains an older commit where src/App.tsx references <Loader2 /> without importing it).

finalOutputVariables.ROOT_CAUSE_LAYER: src/App.tsx in deployed GitHub commit (contains <Loader2 /> in initial loading screen without import from lucide-react)
